criteria: Public, non-archived, non-fork repositories that clear the BCI Relevance Engine (v7): a scored, auditable gate that keeps a repo only when the weight of BCI-specific evidence — acquisition modality, field standard, named hardware, explicit BCI topic or paradigm — exceeds generic-ML signals. Each kept repo carries its signed evidence ledger. Ranked by recency and stars.

brs.recompute: take a project's relevance_ledger from this payload and run it through axonos-brs; the score must match. A disagreement is a bug report this project cannot argue with.

methodology.note: Inclusion is not endorsement; AxonOS is scored by the same formula as every project. The BRS gate and domain facets are deterministic and auditable; enriched signals are real GitHub data; money-raised and legal domicile, when shown, are curated.
